svg.aria-label: An acceptance interlock. A separate approval plate clamps a prepared document. One crossbar couples quota reservation and outbox insertion in D1. A queue magazine leads to provider handoff. A separate stopped tray holds submission_unknown for reconciliation, with no automatic retry. Provider acceptance is distinct from delivery.

The small cobalt envelope marks an illustrative document, not a live operation.
